zh.d: 第一次打开 One Work 不用再自己去注册模型服务、复制粘贴 API Key。首页会出现「一键体验免费模型」，点一下就能拿到一个可以直接对话的模型，每台设备一次。领到的模型会作为一条普通的模型服务出现在设置里，可以随时修改或删除。
从这个版本起，One Work 由我们自己的三个代码仓库独立构建，不再跟随此前的开源上游项目。这次换代对使用没有影响，版本号从 2.2.0 重新起步作为分界。

en.t: Try a free model in one click
en.d: Opening One Work for the first time no longer means signing up for a model provider and pasting an API key. A "Try Free Models" option now appears on the home screen — one click gets you a working model, once per device. It lands in Settings as an ordinary model service you can edit or remove at any time.

From this release, One Work is built entirely from our own three repositories rather than following the previous open-source upstream. Nothing changes for you day to day; the version restarts at 2.2.0 to mark the line.
